dedupe_keys.name: eia cleaned hourly electricity demand data

description: The Carnegie Institution for Science research team publishes cleaned hourly electricity demand for balancing authorities in the contiguous United States. The source observations come from the US Energy Information Administration, and the deposited release spans four continuous years from 2 July 2015 through 1 July 2019. Zenodo preserves version 1.1 of the data repository as a ZIP package under CC BY 4.0, allowing free reuse. The record explicitly links the separate code archive that produced the cleaned series. These hourly demands can drive dispatch, capacity-expansion and network-flow simulations, complementing the European coverage of data-re-europe. A caveat is that cleaned values include statistical replacements and should not all be interpreted as original meter observations. The deposit is a fixed historical release, and subsequent revisions to the EIA source may prevent exact reproduction from a fresh query. The review verified the public metadata and cross-links but did not download the data package or evaluate its imputed values.
